notes.title: Sale for October festivities!
notes.content:
To Ash is back to just 99¢!
I'll be in Florida for Emerald Coast Con http://emeraldcon.com
Oct 8th and 9th for a panel! So try and check it out if you are in that area!

Also, October last year was when the latest RPGmaker came out, which really helped me put more polish on the game (even though I had to remake a good portion of it when transferring things)

notes.title: Spoiler-Free (mostly) walkthrough is up!
notes.content:
I hope everyone is enjoying the game so far. I just posted a walkthrough for anyone who may be stuck on a section!

http://steamcommunity.com/app/453950/guides/

Please address anything else in discussions and I will make sure to check it regularly if you need help with battles, strategies, or find any bugs of course.

Have a good day!
